blocks.text: Pollution par qaboo in tareeqon (strategies) se kiya ja sakta hai:

items: Industries aur municipalities (baladiyat) ke liye sakht discharge standards (ganda pani chhorne ke mayaar) lagu karna, taake nuqsan-deh pollutants pani mein na jayein.

Sewage treatment plants (STPs) ko behtar aur bara karna, Effluent Treatment Plants (ETPs, yani factory ka ganda pani saaf karne ke plants) lagana, aur modern technologies apnana, jaise membrane filtration aur bioreactors.
Pani ki quality ki continuous monitoring (lagataar nigrani), jis se pollutants ka jaldi pata chalta hai aur contamination events (gandagi ke waqiat) par waqt par action liya ja sakta hai.

Polluters (pollution phailane walon) par sakht penalties (jurmane) aur clean practices (saaf tareeqe) apnane walon ko incentives (inaam). Is se environmental violations (mahol ke qanoon torna) kam hoti hain aur industries aur communities (logon) ko sustainable (der tak chalne wale), pollution-free kaam karne ka shauq milta hai.

blocks.prompt: Do tareeqe batayein jin se government (hukoomat) pani ki pollution par qaboo pa sakti hai.
blocks.explanation: In mein se koi do: sakht discharge standards; STPs aur ETPs lagana aur behtar karna; pani ki quality ki continuous monitoring; polluters par penalties aur saaf tareeqon par incentives.

items: Discharge standards; STPs aur ETPs; continuous monitoring; penalties aur incentives.
